How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

Questions to ask the vendor (7)

  1. How many full-time employees does Black Kite have, and how many work in engineering and customer support?
    Headcount indicates capacity to support a large bank deployment.
  2. Has Black Kite reduced headcount in the last 24 months, and if so by how much and in which teams?
    Recent layoffs can signal financial pressure or reduced support capacity.
  3. Has Black Kite (NormShield, Inc.) been the subject of any regulatory investigation, enforcement action or order in the last five years?
    Enforcement action against a supplier bears on its suitability.
  4. Has Black Kite experienced any security incident affecting customer data or its platform in the last five years, and how were customers notified?
    A supplier's own breach history bears on the trust a bank can place in it.
  5. Has Black Kite lost any customer in the financial sector in the last 24 months, and why?
    Loss of large customers can signal product or service problems.
  6. Have there been any departures of executive officers or governance concerns at Black Kite in the last 24 months?
    Leadership instability or misconduct affects delivery and governance.
  7. What is Black Kite's price list for the Monitor, Assess and Extend packages, and how does price scale with the number of monitored vendors?
    Banks need a cost basis to compare suppliers.
